rules.title: The rules
rules.roll: Each match, you are given a weapon at random, with a random headgear, clothing and shoes. Each piece of gear is used once in a run.
rules.win: Win with that set before you get the next one. Nothing is skipped and nothing is drawn again.
rules.lives: You start with 1 life and earn another for every 10 wins.
rules.reset: Lose your last life and you go back to the start: win again with every weapon you already beat, in the same order, with the same gear.
rules.end: The run is over when you have won with every weapon in the game.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Iron Squid keeps your run in your own browser. This is everything it keeps, where it is kept, and who else sees anything when you visit.
privacy.item.run: Your run: the order of its sets, the results you report, your lives and resets, and the log of every match.
privacy.item.name: The display name you give a run, if you give one.
privacy.item.language: The language you choose, once the site offers more than one.
privacy.where: All of it is kept only in this browser, on this device. The site sends none of it anywhere: there is no server of ours, no account, no cookie and no analytics.
privacy.name: A display name is visible to anyone who receives a link to your run. Leave it empty if you would rather not be named.
privacy.host: GitHub serves the site, through GitHub Pages, and receives what any web host receives when you visit: your IP address, your browser's description of itself, and the address you asked for. The project has no access to those records.
privacy.dns: Cloudflare resolves the site's domain name. It sees the lookups made by your DNS resolver, not your visits to the site.
privacy.request: To ask about any of this, open an issue on the project's GitHub repository, or send a private report for anything sensitive. Requests about the records GitHub keeps as the host go to GitHub.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.what: Iron Squid is a free fan project that runs a Splatoon 3 challenge in your browser. It is played on the honour system: the site cannot see your matches, and keeps the results you report.
terms.warranty: The site is offered as it is, with no warranty. A run lives in your browser and is lost if your browser's data is cleared.
terms.licence: The site's code is under the MIT licence. Splatoon, its names and its images belong to Nintendo and are not covered by that licence.
terms.data: What the site keeps, and where, is in the privacy notice.
terms.changes: These terms may change; the version on this page is the one that applies.
